title: Volcano Activity Notice
description: A volcano observatory notice describing current activity: the volcano, the volcano alert level together with its aviation color code (NORMAL/GREEN, ADVISORY/YELLOW, WATCH/ORANGE, WARNING/RED), a summary of recent observations, hazards, and when the next update is expected. Both are always written as words.

colorCode.description: Aviation color code. It pairs with the alert level: NORMAL/GREEN, ADVISORY/YELLOW, WATCH/ORANGE, WARNING/RED

previousLevel.description: Previous level and color code if changed

summary.description: Summary of recent activity in plain language
examples: Earthquake activity beneath the volcano has increased over the past 24 hours, with more than 180 small earthquakes located at depths of 3 to 8 km. GPS stations show the summit has risen about 4 cm since Monday.

observations.description: Key observations as short lines (up to 6)

examples: Seismicity: 180 located earthquakes in 24 hours, largest M 2.4.
Hazards are confined to the summit area. An eruption could send ash into the air and generate lahars in the river valleys on the volcano's west side.

nextUpdate.description: When the next notice is expected
examples: Daily at 09:00 PST, or sooner if activity changes.
